responsibility: This file manages the optabs subsystem’s mapping from abstract operations to runtime library entry points. It owns per-target libfunc tables and hashing, lazy lookup and initialization of normal and conversion optab libcalls, generation and renaming of canonical libgcc/libc symbol names, creation of DECL/SYMBOL_REF nodes for library routines with visibility handling, and initialization of target-adjustable libfunc mappings including sync/atomic helper families.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file in the `optabs-libfuncs` group: it builds and lazily initializes the optab-to-libfunc mappings, libfunc declarations/symbol refs, naming, visibility, and target-specific initialization tables, whereas `gcc/optabs-libfuncs.h` only declares those lookup and setup services.
